# Weight table

Six axes, 0–2 each; W is their sum. Why each rule is what it is: the plugin's `docs/weight.md`.

| Axis | Measured by | Table |
|---|---|---|
| scope | references | bands: [0, 5]; hot_paths: ["hooks/**", "src/Shared/**"] |
| behaviour | session | keywords: ["workflow", "transition", "state machine", "messenger", "queue", "async", "transaction"] |
| reversibility | paths+content | needs_step: ["**/migrations/**", "**/Migrations/**", "config/**", "k8s/**", "**/env/**"]; irreversible: ["**/prod/**", "**/production/**", "deploy/**", "**/*.deploy.*"]; irreversible_content: ["DROP ", "TRUNCATE", "DELETE FROM", "ALTER .* DROP", "RENAME"] |
| domain | modules+session | modules: ["**/Payment/**", "**/Tax/**", "**/Invoice/**", "**/Security/**", "**/account/**"]; customer_visible: ["templates/**", "**/Shop/**", "**/Resources/views/**"] |
| novelty | session | manifests: ["composer.json", "requirements*.txt", "package.json", "pyproject.toml", "Gemfile"] |
| coverage | tests-map | code_globs: ["**/*.php", "**/*.py", "**/*.js", "**/*.ts", "**/*.sh"]; test_globs: ["tests/**", "spec/**", "**/*Test.php", "**/*.test.*", "**/*.spec.*", "**/test_*.py"]; map: {} |

| Mode | When | Plan | Review | Reviewer | Human stops | Suite |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| light | W ≤ 2 | inline | on_red_fact | BALANCED | 0 | verify |
| guarded | W ≤ 7 | plan_mode | one | BALANCED | 1 | verify+e2e |
| full | W ≥ 8 or reversibility or domain = 2 | written | one | STRONG | 2 | verify+e2e |
| full_irreversible | reversibility=2 and domain=2, or irreversible_content | as full | as full | as full | 3 | as full |

| Hint paths | Axis | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `**/login*`, `**/Security/**`, `**/*Auth*` | domain +1 | auth-shaped path |
| `.ai/policies/**`, `.claude/**`, `.codex/**`, `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md` | behaviour +1 | pipeline |
| `composer.json`, `package.json`, `requirements*.txt` | novelty +1 | dependency manifest |
